annotations.text:
Date is the master context.
Pick a day (calendar, arrows, Week/Month chart bar) and EVERYTHING follows it — title, KPIs, sessions, timeline, apps, work type, insights — with a cross-fade and the numbers rolling.
The hero collapses to a one-line NOW strip on any day but today, so a past day can never be mistaken for now, and 'Back to today' is one click.

Sessions card — new, and the thing that was missing.
The day's focus sessions as rows: time range, name, type, worked, stretches; the breaks between them inline with their names ('Dinner · 40m'). What used to be called 'Session log' becomes 'App usage'.

Everything links.
Hover a session → its span frames on the timeline and its apps brighten in App share. Click it → Focused shows the session, the timeline frames it, App share filters to the apps used inside it, a chip names it; × or Esc clears. Hover an app row → its blocks brighten on the timeline. Click a rhythm bar → that hour.

Right data in the right place.
The calendar's figure under a date, the KPI Focused on that date, and the Sessions card's total are one number from one source. Records inflated by the pre-22-Aug idle bug can be repaired (capped to hands-on time inside their span) — your call.
